fixedReportedIssues.issue: permission denied for table profiles during message hydration
fixedReportedIssues.cause: Wildcard profile reads include columns not granted to the client.
fixedReportedIssues.fix: Shared authenticated retrieval uses the current official 42-column public projection, validates returned identities and batches requests.
fixedReportedIssues.scope: Public zero-row probes and mocked protocol regression; no real account data.

fixedReportedIssues.cause: URLSession reports cancellation as NSURLErrorCancelled, which previously reached visible error state; pre-canceled tasks could also claim load ownership.
fixedReportedIssues.fix: Normalize transport cancellation to CancellationError, ignore pre-canceled model loads and retain real failures.

fixedReportedIssues.cause: Every subscribed acknowledgement called onReconnect, including confirmations of ordinary channel/topic changes. Resync called observe again, forming a feedback loop.
fixedReportedIssues.fix: Only the first approved user-topic acknowledgement on a replacement socket triggers resync; unchanged topics do not resubscribe. Keep cached messages visible during refresh and preserve in-flight live inserts/edits/deletes.

nativeUnitTests.scope: Synthetic transport/lifecycle tests; the final subsequent correction batch changes primary UI geometry, labels and accessibility only.

initialRun.reason: The Add Friend container identifier propagated to its child buttons, hiding the Send identifier from UI queries.

nativeUIFlows.coverageBasis: Merged passing evidence across initial, affected-state, final Friends and final primary-surface runs; not one clean complete-matrix run.
nativeUIFlows.confirmationFailures: Phone home tests failed only because an exact44pt AX frame converted to43.999999999999986pt; tolerance now0.001pt. iPad revealed a duplicate Friends presentation; the final source reuses its existing stage and its full Home flow passed.

visualEvidence.reference: Latest user-provided reference arrangement, adapted with Yapper colors, Inter, vectors and actual per-account cosmetics. Private reference pixels/usernames are not redistributed.
visualEvidence.activityCards: No invented friend/voice activity cards are shown when authoritative participant/activity data is absent.
visualEvidence.largeFontScope: Pro Max, dark appearance, accessibility-large; normal content size restored afterward.
visualEvidence.reviewVerdict: The supplied frozen-source home now follows the reference density and slim-banner arrangement while preserving Yapper identity. The three initial P2 findings are resolved for the supplied fixture states. No unresolved P0/P1 or new home P2 was identified in the bounded confirmation; live artwork and whole-app equivalence remain unverified.

simulatorRelease.signing: Locally ad-hoc signed with Simulator-only identity section.

packageInspection.scope: Checks inspect exact delivered ZIP/IPA bytes. App sources stayed frozen through final builds and visual confirmation.

verificationLimits.securityScope: Source, request-contract, package and hash inspection are bounded checks, not a comprehensive malware audit or a guarantee about server/dependency behavior.

keychainProbe.scope: Exact shipping SessionVault source compiled in an isolated own-identity Simulator probe; synthetic write/read/update/delete and cleanup, all OSStatus values 0; no user Keychain items read.
